messages.common.messageUnavailable: Details are unavailable. Refresh to review the current information.
messages.error.loadingTitle: This view could not finish loading.
messages.error.connectionLost: The companion connection was lost. Your saved data has not been deleted. Reconnect to the companion and try again.
messages.error.notConfirmed: The operation was not confirmed. Your saved records remain available.
messages.settings.browserOnly: Appearance and language choices apply to this browser.
messages.settings.previewNotice: {name} preview uses English. Full translations are planned for a later checkpoint.
messages.settings.englishNotice: English is the source language. Scientific units and recorded UTC remain unchanged.
messages.settings.notSaved: Your choice applies to this tab. This browser could not save it for next time.
messages.dialog.unsavedWarning: Closing will discard the unsaved edits in this window. Saved data and ongoing operations will be preserved.
messages.components.emptyTitle: No saved data in this selection.
messages.settings.hostScope: Saved for this companion profile across restarts. Browser overrides stay in this browser. Units, scientific data and permissions are unchanged.
messages.settings.hostFollow: Use companion defaults in this browser
messages.settings.hostReadOnly: Companion defaults are read-only on paired devices. Change them on the companion PC.
messages.settings.hostUnavailable: Companion defaults are unavailable. Reconnect to review them; browser choices remain available.
messages.settings.hostSaved: Companion defaults saved. Reopen existing Windows dialogs to refresh their appearance. Other Windows dialog text remains English.
messages.settings.hostNativeNotice: The MSFS toolbar retains its readable dark appearance. Non-English choices are English previews, not complete translations.
messages.toolbar.catalogFallback: English fallback: the companion or catalog version is unavailable or incompatible.
messages.toolbar.catalogPreview: {name} preview uses bundled English; full translations are not available.
messages.home.intro: Choose your next step. Prepare a mission, record a flight, or review what you saved.
messages.home.resultsMeaning: These are saved flight records. Scientific evidence and limitations are checked in the original review.
messages.home.nextDetail.active: Open Current Flight to check science collection, add an observation or finish recording. Recording and science collection are separate.
messages.home.nextDetail.draft: Your unsaved edits are still in the planner in this browser. Review and save them before preparing a flight.
messages.home.nextDetail.plan: A saved mission plan is selected. Review its requirements in Prepare; recording and science collection keep their separate original controls.
messages.home.nextDetail.idle: Choose an experiment in Missions and review its setup. Simulator connection alone does not establish scientific readiness.
messages.home.nextDetail.connect: Open the companion on your PC and load a flight in MSFS. You can also prepare missions while disconnected.
messages.home.nextDetail.unavailable: Current activity could not be confirmed. Reconnect the companion or refresh status. No recording or science change has been requested.
messages.home.connection.stale: Simulator telemetry is out of date
messages.home.synthetic: SIMULATED TEST TELEMETRY — not an installed MSFS flight
messages.home.retained: Retained original observations: {original} · Derived observations: {derived} · Remote products: {products}. Counts do not establish scientific quality or completion.
messages.home.countsUnknown: Retained scientific counts are unavailable here. Open the original flight review to check evidence.
messages.home.stale: Activity is out of date or unavailable. Recording and science status are unconfirmed; reconnect or refresh before acting.
messages.home.telemetryWarning: Recording is confirmed by the companion, but current simulator input is unavailable or paused. Check Current Flight for collection holds and recovery.
messages.home.planUnavailable: The selected plan could not be loaded. Review the original selection in Current Flight; no unplanned flight was substituted.
messages.home.noPlan: No saved mission plan is selected.
messages.home.archiveAvailable: Archive available at the last successful check. Open a flight to review its exact saved scope.
messages.home.archiveEmpty: No saved flights to show yet. Choose a mission to begin.
messages.home.archiveUnavailable: The archive could not be checked. Saved results may still exist; reconnect and refresh to check availability.
messages.home.resultStatus.completed: Recording completed · science evidence requires review
messages.home.resultStatus.interrupted: Recording interrupted · review retained evidence and gaps
messages.home.noActiveCounts: Science collection starts separately from flight recording.
messages.home.collectionWarning: Science collection reports a hold or storage problem. New qualifying science is not confirmed. Open Current Flight to inspect the original status and recovery controls.
messages.missions.exploreIntro: Start with a question. Fly Now prepares a local mission; recording and science collection have their own explicit controls.
messages.missions.noMatches: No matching experiments. Try a shorter question or open your saved experiments.
messages.missions.emptyCatalog: No starter experiments are available from this companion. Saved plans and custom experiments remain accessible.
messages.missions.catalogUnavailable: The experiment catalog could not be confirmed. Refresh to check its actual requirements; saved experiments and plans may still exist.
messages.missions.savedUnavailable: Saved experiments could not be checked. Open My Research to retry; no saved work was removed.
messages.missions.noSavedExperiments: No saved experiments were returned. Fly Now can prepare your first local experiment, or use My Research to create a custom one.
messages.missions.receiptMismatch: The preparation reply does not match this request. Nothing was selected or started. Retry to check the same preparation identity.
messages.missions.selectionMismatch: The companion did not confirm this plan selection. No recording or science was started. Retry or review the original mission selector.
messages.missions.activeFlight: Recording is active: {name}. Prepare later work without changing this flight; use Current Flight for its controls.
messages.missions.selectionUnavailable: The selected saved plan could not be confirmed. Review the original selection in Current Flight; no unplanned flight was substituted.
messages.missions.noSelection: Choose an experiment below, or open a saved mission plan. Selection alone does not record a flight.
messages.missions.unsupported: This experiment definition or version is unsupported here. Review it in My Research; no substitute experiment will be prepared.
messages.missions.experience.guided: Guided tasks — review the targets for your aircraft
messages.missions.experience.altitudes: Guided altitude changes — choose achievable bands
messages.missions.experience.locations: Some setup — distinct locations and supported sampling gaps
messages.missions.experience.sources: More setup — external source compatibility and availability
messages.missions.experience.model: Advanced interpretation — a fictional model, not hardware
messages.missions.aircraft: Review achievable targets; fresh, valid, unpaused MSFS input is required. This does not certify aircraft capability.
messages.missions.input.flight: Original recorded indicated airspeed, MSL altitude and supported continuous time. Card activation and attempts remain separate.
messages.missions.input.atmosphere: Original simulator air-temperature readings at supported aircraft locations. Pressure, wind and density depend on what the simulator supplies.
messages.missions.input.survey: Each selected measurement keeps its own source, units, location and QA. DEM terrain is not LiDAR; historical land-surface temperature is not simulator air temperature.
messages.missions.input.notes: Pilot notes, host UTC and available aircraft positions. Optional supporting instruments require separately retained scientific evidence.
messages.missions.input.model: Original simulator air temperature is required. A fictional response is derived from saved valid readings; it is not a physical sensor measurement.
messages.missions.noInstruments: No scientific instruments required for this selection
messages.missions.instrumentsUnknown: Instrument metadata unavailable — review before preparing
messages.missions.externalSources: Compatible retained external datasets are required for the selected external instruments. Original dates, datum, location and QA still need review. No download is approved here.
messages.missions.localSources: These starter inputs can be prepared locally without an external scene or cloud account. Existing readiness and source checks still apply to recording and collection.
messages.missions.metadataUnavailable: The actual instrument requirements could not be confirmed. Refresh the catalog or inspect the original planner; readiness is not inferred.
messages.missions.modelWarning: Fictional modeled output — no physical or MSFS-mounted experimental sensor is validated.
messages.missions.notesWarning: Pilot documentation is not a sensor measurement or proof of a hypothesis.
messages.missions.prepareOnly: Fly Now prepares and selects a mission. It starts no recording, collection, download or sharing.
messages.missions.prepareIntro: Review the exact saved plan, experiment revisions and actual source/storage findings. You can prepare offline; recording still needs the original startup checks.
messages.missions.separateScience: For a new selected plan, review Start Recording in Current Flight. This guided path leaves science armed for a separate Start Science Collection action. Card activation, downloads and sharing stay separate.
messages.missions.planUnavailable: This exact saved plan could not be loaded. Refresh or choose it in the original mission selector; no unplanned flight was substituted.
messages.missions.stateUnavailable: Current simulator and selection state are unconfirmed. Reconnect or refresh; no recording or science change was requested.
messages.missions.selectionDifferent: This plan is being reviewed, but it is not the confirmed selected plan. Use the original Current Flight selector before recording. This page will not silently change the selection.
messages.missions.connection.connected: Simulator input is current. This does not establish scientific readiness; review the assessment and original recording controls.
messages.missions.connection.disconnected: Simulator disconnected. Your saved preparation is retained; load an aircraft before attempting to record.
messages.missions.connection.paused: Simulator paused. Your saved preparation is retained; unpause and wait for valid input before recording or collecting.
messages.missions.connection.stale: Simulator input is stale or invalid. Your saved plan is retained; wait for fresh input and review the original controls.
messages.missions.connection.unknown: Companion state unavailable. Refresh before relying on simulator or selection status.
messages.missions.objectiveUnknown: No supported objective is available; inspect the original plan.
messages.missions.geometry: Saved geometry: {waypoints} waypoints · {areas} survey areas. Planned geometry is not measured coverage.
messages.missions.savedInstruments: Enabled instruments in this saved plan: {instruments}
messages.missions.cardMismatch: An experiment reply does not match its saved card identity and revision. Refresh before relying on this preparation.
messages.missions.choosePlan: Choose an experiment or saved mission plan first. This page does not create or select a plan from an incomplete link.
messages.missions.readinessUnassessed: Not yet assessed · evaluate this saved plan without changing it.
messages.missions.invalidReadiness: The readiness reply is invalid or unsupported. Reassess; no scientific readiness or permission is inferred.
messages.missions.title.flight: Hold a steady speed and altitude
messages.missions.goal.flight: Practice the saved speed, altitude and continuous-hold targets.
messages.missions.goal.atmosphere: Collect supported atmospheric readings across changing altitude or sampled locations.
messages.missions.goal.survey: Investigate each selected quantity using its own qualified sampled locations and sources.
messages.missions.goal.notes: Document observations with notes and available position; keep optional measurements separate.
messages.missions.goal.model: Compare original temperature input with the declared fictional response model.
messages.missions.preparationChanged: The preparation context changed while the request was pending. Review the original selection and explicitly prepare the current choices; no recording or science was started.
